senses.gloss:
सृष्ट p. p. [सृज्-क्त]
1 Created,
produced.
--2 Poured out, omitted.
--3 Let loose.
--4 Left, abandoned.
--5 Dismissed, sent away.
--6
Ascertained, determined.
--7
Connected, joined.
--8 Much, abundant,
numerous.
--9 Ornamented; see
सृज्.

सृष्टिः f. [सृज्-क्तिन्]
1 Creation,
anything created; किं मानसी सृष्टिः
Ś. 4; या सृष्टिः स्रष्टुराद्या Ś. 1. 1;
स्त्रीरत्नसृष्टिरपरा प्रतिभाति सा मे Ś. 2. 9;
सृष्टिराद्येव धातुः Me. 82.
--2 The
creation of the world.
--3 Nature,
natural property.
--4 Letting
loose, emission.
--5 Giving away,
a gift.
--6 The existence of
properties or qualities.
--7 The absence
of properties.
--Comp.
--कर्तृ m.
the creator.
